reason: The Plan's u1 (broaden search to open surfaces and appliances) is supported by the current runs: P1 found the box only after reaching coffeetable 1 (P1:36) and succeeded, while P3 and P6 exhausted same-type closed containers and hit the step limit without visiting key appliances/surfaces (P3:outcome, P6:outcome). I keep u1. The anti-cycling u2 is directionally motivated by repeated empty-container revisits (P1:15/P1:20/P1:24, P3:28/P3:48, P6:26) and prior mixed responses to anti-revisit wording (M3, M6), but its conditions 'receptacle you have already confirmed empty' and 'contents you have not yet seen' require a historical inventory the Actor cannot access (only current observation and last two steps). I narrow u2 to local, observable triggers while preserving the anti-cycling intent and the u1 broadening; no clean/cool/placement or desklamp behavior is changed.

+- Do not cycle back and forth among the same small set of receptacles; before you make a second visit to a receptacle you can see in your recent history, first inspect a different listed receptacle type or instance than the one you just visited.
 - Treat a run of steps that only revisits already-open, empty containers as a stuck-search signal: break the pattern by moving to an uninspected surface or appliance instead of repeating the loop.

adjustments.reason: The edit removes two history-dependent conditions from the anti-cycling rule. The Actor cannot maintain a set of all previously confirmed-empty receptacles or know contents it has not seen; it only has the current observation and last two pre-action observation/action pairs. The current runs show the old anti-revisit wording did not stop cycling (P1 revisits cabinets at 15/20/24, P3 at 28/48, P6 at 26) and M3/M6 record the same limitation. The new wording keys the rule to what is observable: leave an empty receptacle shown in the current observation, pick a listed receptacle absent from recent history, and before a second visit to a recently seen receptacle inspect a different type/instance. This is a narrowing for executability, not a claim that the local rule will always break cycles.
